t: Welcome to Fomo Leads: Onboarding Steps
d: Your step-by-step setup guide, with a short follow-along video for every step.
x: We're so happy you're here! 🎉 This guide walks you through everything you need to start getting leads. Every step has a short screen recording of the real dashboard. Watch it, then do the same thing in your own account. Most members finish setup in one sitting, and the first lead usually arrives within 24 hours of finishing setup. 💡 Keep this page open in one tab and your dashboard (https://members.fomoleads.io) in another so you can follow along. 🔐 Step 1: Sign in Go to https://members.fomoleads.io and sign in with the email you signed up with. No password yet? Use Email me a sign-in link . Step 1: Sign in (1:01) - The email is called Your Fomo Leads sign-in link and comes from noreply@fomoleads.io. The link expires in 15 minutes and works once . - Want to skip the email next time? Go to Settings → Password , set a password, and sign in with your email and password. 🧭 Step 2: Tour your dashboard (and how to reach support) Your Dashboard is home base. The Finish account setup checklist shows the two things you need before leads can reach you: choose states and add funds . Step 2: Tour your dashboard (0:54) Use the menu on the left to get around: Menu item What it's for --- --- Dashboard Setup checklist, wallet balance, lead stats and closer stats Leads Every lead you've received, your stats and Export CSV States Performance by state Wallet Trial, plans, adding funds and your locked lead rate Team Add reps to share leads by round-robin Integrations Send leads to your CRM, and GoHighLevel disposition sync Settings Daily leads, coverage states, thank-you page, contact info, password, lead alerts and timezone 💬 Need help? Email our support team at support@fomoleads.io . You'll also find a Contact us link on the sign-in page. 🗺️ Step 3: Choose your coverage states Go to Settings → Coverage states , select every state where you're licensed and want leads, then click Save states . This is required before any new leads can route to you. Step 3: Choose your coverage states (0:35) - Type in Search states to find a state fast, or click states right in the grid. - All selects every state and Clear removes them all. - Only pick states you're licensed in. 📈 Step 4: Set your daily leads In Settings → Daily leads , use + and − to set how many verified leads you want each day, then click Save daily leads . You only pay for the leads you receive. Step 4: Set your daily leads (0:40) 📦 +10 on a busy day: when nobody else covering your states has room, we may send you up to 10 more verified leads , charged at your normal price. 💳 Step 5: Pick a plan and add funds Open Wallet . Start with the one-time trial or choose a membership plan, then add funds. Leads are paid from your wallet. Step 5: Pick a plan and add funds (0:58) Option Price Ad spend you can load --- --- --- Trial $247 one time, no subscription Up to $1,000 Launch $597 per 30 days Up to $3,000 per period Grow (Recommended) $997 per 30 days Up to $6,000 per period Scale $1,497 per 30 days Up to $10,000 per period - Add between $500 and $10,000 at a time. The page shows roughly how many leads that amount buys. - Your Mortgage Protection rate is shown on the page ($21.63 per lead when this guide was made). The rate can change, and it's locked for the funds you add at that time. - The funding button unlocks once you've started the trial or picked a plan. Payments are processed by Whop. 🙋 Step 6: Set up your thank-you page Your thank-you page is what a new lead sees the moment they submit : your photo, your name, your license number, plus a ready-to-send text and your contact card. Set it up in Settings → Your thank-you page profile . Each part has its own save button. Step 6: Set up your thank-you page (1:17) What to put in each field Field Where in Settings What to enter Example Click to save --- --- --- --- --- Photo Photo and license number → Upload photo A clear, well-lit headshot. It's cropped to a circle and shown next to your name. Without one, leads see your initials. Your headshot (uploads when you choose the photo) License number Photo and license number → License number Your license number. Shows as "License No. …" under your name and on your contact card. Leave blank to hide it. TX-1234567 Save license number Number your leads text Use my account number , or uncheck it and fill in Number for lead texts The US mobile number leads text and save. It's behind the Text and Save-contact buttons. Your account cell doesn't change. (214) 726-0193 Save number Text message your leads send you Message box, with Insert buttons The text prefilled in the lead's Messages app when they tap "Text you now". Up to 300 characters. Placeholders: {lead_first_name} , {rep_first_name} , {state} . Hi {rep_first_name}, it's {lead_first_name}. I just got pre-qualified for mortgage protection and I'd like to see my options. Save message Display name Your contact card Your name as leads should see it. It's also the name on your thank-you page. Jordan Ellis Save contact card Title Your contact card Your job title Licensed Insurance Agent Save contact card Company (optional) Your contact card Your agency or company Ellis Family Insurance Save contact card Email (optional) Your contact card The email leads can reach you at jordan@example.com Save contact card Website (optional) Your contact card Your website example.com Save contact card Phone Your contact card Filled in for you from Number your leads text (214) 726-0193 (set it under Number your leads text) 👀 Check the preview. The phone on the right updates as you type. Your version includes unsaved changes; Leads see now shows what's live. For a field-by-field walkthrough with a video for each part, see Set Up Your Thank-You Page . 🔔 Step 7: Turn on lead alerts Go to Settings → Lead alerts and click Turn on lead alerts . When your browser asks, click Allow . Do this on every computer and phone where you want alerts. Step 7: Turn on lead alerts (0:44) - Until alerts are on, you'll also see a reminder at the top of the page with a Turn on link. - 📱 iPhone: alerts only work from the home-screen app. In Safari, tap Share , choose Add to Home Screen , open Fomo Leads from your home screen, then go to Settings → Lead alerts and turn them on. - Once alerts are on, the card says Alerts are on for this device and gives you Send test and Turn off on this device . - If the card says notifications are blocked, turn them on in your device's Settings › Notifications › Fomo Leads , then reload the page. 🔗 Step 8: Connect your CRM (optional) Want leads in your own CRM too? Go to Integrations , paste your CRM's webhook URL into Webhook URL , and click Save . Step 8: Connect your CRM (0:31) For the full walkthrough, including the test payload and GoHighLevel disposition sync, see Sending Leads to Your CRM by Webhook . 🚀 Step 9: What to expect Once your states are saved and your wallet has funds , we run Meta ads in your states and leads start routing to you. Most members get their first lead within 24 hours of finishing setup. Step 9: What to expect (0:30) New leads show up on your Leads page, are sent to your CRM if you connected one, and trigger a lead alert on every device where alerts are on. ✅ You're all set! Questions at any point? Email support@fomoleads.io .

t: Welcome to Fomo Leads: How It Works
d: A quick overview of how Fomo Leads gets exclusive leads to you.
x: Welcome to Fomo Leads ! We're a done-for-you lead service for insurance agents. You don't build campaigns, manage an ad account or set ad budgets. We do that part. How it works 1. Pick a plan and add funds. 2. We run Meta ads in your states. 3. Leads land in your member area and CRM , billed at your locked rate. What leads are available? Mortgage Protection leads are live. Your per-lead rate is shown on the Wallet page ($21.63 as of October 2026) and is locked each time you add funds. Final Expense , General Term and IUL are coming soon, and you can join the waitlist for each one. See Lead categories and the waitlist . Every lead is yours "Real-time, fresh, exclusive leads — yours for life, never resold." Every lead is OTP-verified , which means they confirmed their phone number with a one-time code. Need help? Email support@fomoleads.io .

t: Your Dashboard: Setup Checklist and Stats
d: What every card on your dashboard means.
x: Your dashboard lives at https://members.fomoleads.io/dashboard. Finish account setup Until setup is complete, you'll see a checklist: - Choose states: "Required before any new leads can route to you." - Add funds: "Your wallet balance determines how many leads you can receive." Your stats Card What it shows --- --- Wallet balance Funds available for leads Leads received Leads delivered to you Active states States you're covering Est. leads remaining Roughly how many leads your balance covers Leads worked, Contact rate, Booking rate How you're working your leads Closer stats Your dashboard also tracks AP Closed , Commission , Average AP , Profit , CAC , ROI , AP ROAS and Lead to Close . Use the I closed a deal button to record a sale (see Tracking closes and ROI ). "You're out of leads" If your wallet is empty, you'll see: "You're out of leads. Your wallet is empty, so no new leads are being sent to you right now." Click Add funds to resume delivery .

t: Accepting the Client Lead Agreement
d: What the agreement covers, and why accepting it doesn't charge you.
x: After you sign up, you'll be asked to accept the FOMO Leads Client Lead Agreement . This is the agreement between you and FOMO Leads LLC . How to accept it 1. Type your full name . 2. Tick "I have read and agree..." . 3. Tick "I am authorized to accept this agreement for this account and business." 4. Click Agree and continue . "This step does not charge your payment method. You'll choose your package and funding separately." You'll then land on your wallet page. Key terms in plain English - Your membership renews every 30 days . - Membership fees don't become wallet funds. Leads are paid from your wallet separately. - Wallet loads are prepaid tranches, used oldest first . - Leads are exclusive to you for 30 days under the agreement. - There are no quality refunds or replacements on OTP-verified leads . Other refund requests are reviewed case by case through support@fomoleads.io. - Payments are processed by Whop . - You can cancel future renewals with Manage or cancel billing . Cancellation takes effect at the end of your paid period . Finding your copy later At https://members.fomoleads.io/settings, the Lead agreement section shows your version and who accepted it on which date. It also has Download accepted copy and Read current agreement .

t: Setting a Password vs. Using an Email Sign-In Link
d: Two ways to sign in to your Fomo Leads dashboard.
x: You don't create a password at signup. Signup only asks for your full name, email and phone . After that you can sign in either way. Option 1: Email sign-in link 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/login. 2. Enter your email and click Email me a sign-in link . 3. Open the email and click the link. Option 2: Set a password 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/settings and find Password : "Set a password to sign in without an email link." 2. Enter your New password and Confirm password . 3. Click Set password . Can't find the sign-in email? Check your spam or promotions folder, or email support@fomoleads.io .

t: How the $247 Trial Works
d: Try Fomo Leads once, with no subscription.
x: Try Fomo for $247. "Pay $247 once, then load up to $1,000 in ad spend and get leads in your states. No subscription." How to start 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/wallet. 2. Click Start my trial for $247 . Payments are processed by Whop . 3. Add funds to your wallet. Wallet funds are separate from the $247. 4. Choose your states at https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. Good to know - No recurring charge. The trial doesn't renew. - The $247 doesn't become wallet funds . Your leads are paid from what you load into your wallet, at the Mortgage Protection rate shown on your Wallet page ($21.63 per lead as of October 2026), locked when you add funds. - The trial covers up to $1,000 in ad spend . For more, pick a plan (see Plans and ad-spend caps ).

t: Plans and Ad-Spend Caps
d: Compare the trial and the Launch, Grow and Scale plans.
x: "Choose a plan to unlock funding. Leads are paid from your wallet." Plan Price Ad spend per period Best for --- --- --- --- Trial $247 once Up to $1,000 Trying Fomo, no subscription Launch $597 / 30 days Up to $3,000 One agent getting started Grow (Recommended) $997 / 30 days Up to $6,000 Steady daily flow for a full-time producer Scale $1,497 / 30 days Up to $10,000 Teams and top producers How caps work - Ad-spend caps reset every billing period. - Lead volume depends on your states and how the campaigns perform. - Leads are paid from your wallet at your locked rate . - Unused wallet funds stay in your wallet. Manage your plan at https://members.fomoleads.io/wallet?billing=manage ( Manage or cancel billing ).

t: Adding Funds to Your Wallet and Locked Lead Rates
d: How your prepaid wallet pays for leads, and how your rate is locked.
x: Every lead is paid for from your prepaid wallet . Adding funds 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/wallet. Adding funds unlocks once you've chosen a trial or plan. 2. Enter an amount between $500 and $10,000 , or click Max . 3. The page shows how many leads that buys at your current rate. For example, at a rate of $21.63, $1,500 is about 69 Mortgage Protection leads . 4. Complete checkout. Payments are processed by Whop . Locked lead rates Lead category Price per lead --- --- Mortgage Protection Shown on your Wallet page ($21.63 as of October 2026), "Locked for the funds you add today." Final Expense, General Term, IUL Coming soon The rate can change over time, so always check Your Mortgage Protection rate on the Wallet page. Your rate locks each time you add funds . Each load is a prepaid tranche, and tranches are used oldest first . So leads always come out of your earliest funds, at the rate locked for those funds. When your wallet is empty Delivery stops automatically. Your dashboard shows: "You're out of leads. Your wallet is empty, so no new leads are being sent to you right now." Click Add funds to resume delivery . Tip: Keep an eye on Est. leads remaining on your dashboard so you can top up before you run out.

t: How Do I Cancel or Manage My Billing?
d: Cancel future renewals or update billing.
x: 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/wallet?billing=manage. You can also click Manage or cancel billing in the Lead agreement section of https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. 2. Manage your plan or cancel future renewals there. Payments are processed by Whop . Good to know - Plans renew every 30 days . - Cancelling stops future renewals. It takes effect at the end of your paid period . - Unused wallet funds stay in your wallet. - Membership fees don't become wallet funds. Questions? Email support@fomoleads.io .

t: Choosing Your States
d: Tell us where you're licensed so you only get leads there.
x: Choosing states is required before any new leads can route to you . 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/settings and find Coverage states . 2. Select your licensed states. You can pick from all 50 states plus DC. All and Clear help you select quickly. 3. Click Save states . There's nothing to relaunch, because we run the ads for you. See how each state is doing: https://members.fomoleads.io/states shows a per-state performance table (see Viewing state performance ).

t: Viewing State Performance
d: See which of your states are delivering and converting.
x: https://members.fomoleads.io/states shows a performance table for each state . - Switch between the Dispositioned and All leads tabs. - Use search to find a state, and the volume filter to focus on busier states. To change which states you cover, go to Coverage states in https://members.fomoleads.io/settings.

t: Setting Your Daily Leads and the Busy-Day +10
d: Control how many leads you get each day.
x: 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. 2. Move the Daily leads slider. The default is 15 . 3. Click Save daily leads . You'll see your cap, for example: "Your cap today: 15, +10 on a busy day." What's the busy-day +10? "On a busy day, when nobody else covering your states has room, we may send you up to 10 more verified leads, charged at your normal price." Things that affect your daily volume - Your wallet balance . Delivery stops at $0. - Your plan's ad-spend cap . - Your coverage states and how the campaigns perform.

t: Where Can I See My Leads?
d: Find every lead and its stats in one place.
x: All your leads are at https://members.fomoleads.io/leads. - Use the All time filter to change the date range. - The stat cards show your balance, est. leads, leads, AP closed, cost per lead, contacts, contact rate, closes, closing rate and CAC. - Move each lead through its outcome stages: contacted , booked , no-show , presented , closed or archived . - Click Export CSV to download your leads (see Exporting leads to CSV ).

t: Tracking Closes and ROI
d: Record your sales and see your real return.
x: 1. Click I closed a deal on https://members.fomoleads.io/dashboard. You can also mark a lead closed in https://members.fomoleads.io/leads. 2. Your dashboard updates your closer stats: AP Closed , Commission , Average AP , Profit , CAC , ROI , AP ROAS and Lead to Close . Using GoHighLevel? Your pipeline stages and AP can sync back automatically. See GoHighLevel disposition sync .

t: Exporting Leads to CSV
d: Download your leads as a spreadsheet.
x: 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/leads. 2. Set the date filter (for example All time ). 3. Click Export CSV . 4. Open the file in Excel, Google Sheets or your CRM's import tool.

t: Lead Exclusivity, OTP Verification and Refunds
d: What makes a Fomo Leads lead, and how refunds work.
x: Exclusive "Every lead is yours. Real-time, fresh, exclusive leads — yours for life, never resold." The Client Lead Agreement guarantees 30-day lead exclusivity . OTP-verified Every lead confirmed their phone number with a one-time code before submitting. Refunds - No quality refunds or replacements are given on OTP-verified leads. - Other refund requests are reviewed case by case . Email support@fomoleads.io with the lead's name and the date it arrived. - Unused wallet funds stay in your wallet.

t: Sending Leads to Your CRM by Webhook
d: Push every new lead into your CRM automatically, and sync GoHighLevel stages back to Fomo Leads.
x: Fomo Leads can send every lead to your CRM as JSON the moment it's assigned to you . Set it up in Integrations (https://members.fomoleads.io/integrations). 🔗 1. Connect your CRM webhook Copy the inbound webhook URL from your CRM, paste it into Webhook URL and click Save . Then send a test. Connect your CRM webhook (1:00) 1. In your CRM, create an automation or workflow with an inbound webhook trigger and copy its URL. 2. In Fomo Leads, open Integrations from the left menu. 3. Paste the URL into Webhook URL and click Save . 4. Check that Automatic delivery is On , so new leads are pushed to your endpoint as they arrive. 5. Click Send test payload . It unlocks once a URL is saved, and sends a sample lead with the event lead.test . Your endpoint should respond with HTTP 200 . No real lead data is sent. 🧾 2. Map the fields Real leads arrive with the event lead.assigned . The Example payload & field mapping panel shows the exact JSON. Click Copy to grab it while you map fields in your CRM. Field What it is --- --- event lead.assigned ( lead.test for test sends) lead.id Unique lead identifier lead.lead_type Product type, e.g. mortgage_protection lead.state US state, 2-letter code lead.first_name / lead.last_name Contact name lead.email Contact email address lead.phone Contact phone number lead.payload.age Selected age range, e.g. 50-59 lead.payload.mortgage_balance Selected mortgage balance range lead.payload.zip ZIP code lead.payload.otp_verified Phone verification status, when recorded lead.created_at ISO 8601 time the lead was delivered to you 🔁 3. GoHighLevel: sync stages back to Fomo Leads When your team moves a lead to a new stage in GoHighLevel, its stage in Fomo Leads updates too, so your stats stay current without double entry. GoHighLevel disposition sync (1:18) 1. In GoHighLevel dispositions , click Create webhook URL . This makes a private URL for your workflow. Anyone with it can update your leads' stages, so keep it inside GoHighLevel. 2. In GoHighLevel, open Automation → Workflows and create a new workflow. 3. Add the trigger Pipeline stage changed . To also catch deals marked won or lost, add Opportunity status changed as a second trigger. 4. Add the action Webhook (or Custom webhook ) and set the method to POST . 5. Paste your webhook URL into the URL field. 6. Under Custom Data , add stage with the value {{opportunity.pipeline_stage}} , and ap with the field where you record annual premium. If you keep the FOMO lead ID in a custom field, add fomo_lead_id too (optional). 7. Save the workflow and publish it. - Each update is matched to your lead by FOMO lead ID when it's sent, otherwise by phone, then email. Only your own leads can change. - Under Your stage names , tell us what your GoHighLevel stages mean with Add stage name , then click Save stage names . Names only count when the whole name matches (ignoring capitals, spaces and symbols), a lead never moves backward, and sold deals need an AP. - Recent activity shows each update once your workflow is live. Click Refresh to check for new ones.

t: GoHighLevel Disposition Sync
d: Send your pipeline stages and AP from GoHighLevel back to Fomo Leads.
x: Sync your GoHighLevel pipeline stages back to Fomo Leads so your stats stay accurate. GoHighLevel disposition sync (1:18) In Fomo Leads 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/integrations and find GoHighLevel dispositions . 2. Click Create webhook URL . This makes your private URL. In GoHighLevel 1. Open Automation Workflows and create a workflow. 2. Add the trigger Pipeline stage changed . Also add Opportunity status changed if you want won/lost to sync. 3. Add a Webhook action and set the method to POST . 4. Paste your Fomo Leads URL. 5. Under Custom Data , add stage = {{opportunity.pipeline_stage}} , ap , and optionally fomo_lead_id . 6. Save and publish . Match your stage names Back in Fomo Leads, use Your stage names to map your GoHighLevel stages. Click Add stage name , then Save stage names . Check Recent activity and click Refresh to confirm updates are arriving.

t: Turning On Push Lead Alerts
d: Get a browser notification when a lead is assigned to you.
x: Fomo Leads sends a browser push notification whenever a lead is assigned to you. Look for the Lead alerts section at https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. 1. Open https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. 2. When your browser asks to show notifications, click Allow . Notifications blocked? Turn them on in your device's Settings › Notifications › Fomo Leads , then reload the page. Note: Lead alerts are push only . There are no email or SMS lead notifications.

t: How Will I Be Notified of New Leads?
d: Where new leads show up and how you're alerted.
x: - Browser push alerts when a lead is assigned to you (see Turning on push lead alerts ). - Your member area: every lead appears at https://members.fomoleads.io/leads. - Your CRM: connect a webhook at https://members.fomoleads.io/integrations and leads are sent there automatically. Fomo Leads does not send email or SMS lead notifications.

t: Adding Reps and Round-Robin Lead Distribution
d: Share leads across your team automatically.
x: "Reps receive leads via fair-queue rotation and can disposition them." 1. Go to https://members.fomoleads.io/team. 2. Click Add rep . "Add a rep and they'll receive leads via round-robin rotation." Each new lead goes to the next rep in line, and reps can update the outcome of their leads.

t: Can I Remove a State?
d: Yes. Update your states yourself any time.
x: Yes! Go to Coverage states in https://members.fomoleads.io/settings, unselect the state and click Save states . There's nothing to relaunch.

t: I'm Getting Leads in States I'm Not Licensed In
d: Check your coverage states, and what to do about an out-of-state lead.
x: 1. Go to Coverage states in https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. Make sure only your licensed states are selected, then click Save states . 2. If a lead still arrives from outside your states, email support@fomoleads.io with the lead's details. Refunds other than quality refunds are reviewed case by case .

t: How Do I Get More Leads?
d: Simple ways to increase your lead volume.
x: 1. Raise your daily leads at https://members.fomoleads.io/settings ( Save daily leads ). 2. Add more licensed states in Coverage states . 3. Keep your wallet funded at https://members.fomoleads.io/wallet. Delivery stops at $0. 4. Move to a bigger plan for a higher ad-spend cap: Launch $3,000, Grow $6,000 or Scale $10,000 per period. 5. Busy days: you may get up to 10 extra verified leads when others in your states are full.

t: How Long Does It Take to Get Leads?
d: What needs to be in place before leads start.
x: Leads can start once both setup steps on your dashboard are done: - Choose states: "Required before any new leads can route to you." - Add funds: "Your wallet balance determines how many leads you can receive." Once setup is finished, your first lead typically arrives in under 24 hours . After that, lead volume depends on your states and how the campaigns perform.

t: I Got a Text From a Lead, But I Don't See the Lead in My Dashboard
d: What to do if a lead texts you before showing up in Fomo Leads.
x: Leads can text the number on your thank-you page right after they submit, so a text can arrive before you see the lead. 1. Refresh https://members.fomoleads.io/leads and check that the date filter is set to All time . 2. If you use a CRM webhook, check your CRM. Leads are sent with the event lead.assigned . 3. If it's still missing, email support@fomoleads.io with the phone number and the time of the text.

t: Does the Thank-You Page Show the Number I'll Be Calling From?
d: It shows the number you set in Settings.
x: The thank-you page shows the Number your leads text that you saved at https://members.fomoleads.io/settings, along with your contact card. Use the number you'll call from so leads recognize you. See Setting up your thank-you page profile and text number .

t: Are Lead Notifications Instant?
d: Push alerts go out when a lead is assigned to you.
x: Yes. Fomo Leads sends a browser push notification when a lead is assigned to you . If alerts don't arrive, enable notifications in your device's Settings › Notifications › Fomo Leads and reload. There are no email or SMS alerts.

t: How Can I Avoid My Phone Number Being Marked as Spam?
d: Spam labels come from your phone or dialer provider. Here's what helps.
x: Phone carriers and dialer providers apply spam labels, not Fomo Leads. These help: - Use a registered business number in your dialer or CRM, and rotate numbers if one gets flagged. - Call from the number leads see on your thank-you page. Set it under Number your leads text in https://members.fomoleads.io/settings. - Reach out quickly. Push lead alerts tell you when a lead is assigned to you.

t: How Do I Contact Support?
d: The way to reach the Fomo Leads team.
x: Email support@fomoleads.io . There's no in-app chat. Include: - The email on your Fomo Leads account. - What you were trying to do, and any error you saw. - For a lead issue: the lead's name and the date it arrived.
